mentions.name: Probe
mentions.description: This app stitches multi-week bikepacking and cycling trips together into a story format, and includes a comparison engine that translates trip metrics into relatable terms (e.g., how many doughnuts the trip equals), for adventures that performance-focused cycling tools miss.
mentions.problem: Cycling trip tools are geared towards performance and assume short Monday-to-Sunday trips, missing the mark for multi-week bikepacking adventures.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I want to bring their bikepacking adventures alive in a story format. Cycling trips are often not Monday to Sunday. They might be a few weeks! Everything is geared towards performance. This misses the mark a little bit. I made this app to stitch a trip together. It also has a comparison engine which asks questions like - how many doughnuts? - to translate the trip into things everyone will understand.

https://probe.bike
